headline: AI-chip rout: CRDO -10.5%, QCOM/ADI -8%, NXPI/KEYS -7.6%, LRCX/MRVL -5-6%, CAT -5.5%. SK Hynix HBM4 slowdown + Broadcom capex miss. CWAN merger-arb closed June 25 at $24.55.

AEM new RED — Q2 gold crash -14% ($4,861→$4,040/oz) matches thesis key_risk #1 (AMBER→RED). MARA/HUT new AMBER on crypto weakness and Q1 EPS miss. STLD new AMBER on Q2 margin squeeze. LRCX/KEYS downgraded AMBER on recovery. CAT + ADI resolved GREEN. MRVL/CRDO/QCOM persisting RED.

DVN guidance-suspension risk resolved GREEN. CWAN roster issue persists unresolved (3rd run).

LRCX -10.19%, MRVL -9.85%, CRDO -6.66%, HUT -8.11% persist RED (HUT now diverging from bitcoin's partial rebound). AMD and TSM price flags cooled to AMBER/resolved; TSM July 16 earnings added to calendar watch. GPC +12.91% on Bloomberg-reported O'Reilly bid for NAPA unit (informational). CWAN roster issue persists unresolved (4th run); NYSE Form 25-NSE delisting effective 2026-07-06.

Next new data expected Monday pre-market.
